about: MCALL in front of a cycle call makes it modal: the MCALL line drills nothing and gets no mark, every positioning block after it runs the cycle (a G1 or G0 block as well), until MCALL stands alone. A tapping cycle is a thread, CYCLE84 (lead among its arguments) as well as CYCLE840 (lead from the feed), on its own line and at the positions under MCALL.
input: G90 G17 G0 X0 Y0 Z5
